description: This header defines template classes and functions for managing plugin interfaces, including reference management, interface creation, and builder pattern for plugin interface configuration within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceRef
classes.description: A smart reference wrapper for plugin interface pointers, managing reference counting and resource cleanup.

classes.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating plugin interface references with specified parameters like callsign, version, timeout, and associated shell service.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates and returns an interface instance for a given builder, querying the interface from the controller.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: A utility template function to create a std::unique_ptr for a given type with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceRef::Reset
methods.description: Releases the interface resource and resets the pointer.

methods.name: PluginInterfaceBuilder::createInterface
methods.description: Builds and returns a plugin interface reference based on the current configuration.
